story: James Henn, 28, was stabbed in the neck during an alleged argument in Nasson Street, Hawston, at about 23:00 on Friday 2 October and was declared dead at the scene. Hermanus police registered a murder case and three suspects were arrested (Daily Voice, quoting police spokesperson Ndakhe Gwala).
